open_obligations: Check that the authors' own results show gains over the solo-verifier baseline (p9 L48-L55) of a kind comparable to Khan et al.'s judge-accuracy gains
Note that the authors do not test whether stronger provers help more, which is the capability part of Khan et al.'s claim
out.other_title: Debate helps non-expert LLM and human judges on QuALITY; persuasive debaters help more
out.rationale: The authors explicitly place their findings (modest accuracy gains over a solo verifier, larger worst-case gains) alongside Khan et al.'s debate results as evidence pointing the same way, which is SUPPORTS. Settings differ: Khan et al. use inference-time debate on QuALITY reading comprehension with an information asymmetry, the authors train verifiers on code validation.
out.scope: proposed SUPPORTS: Whether interaction with stronger models helps a weaker judge or verifier; the agreement is tentative and holds at the level of overall direction, not specific accuracy numbers
